tools.name: get_approaches
tools.description: Use to compare the different ways a job can be done before choosing one: source-backed approach families, methods, lenses and needed tools. Not needed to do a job (start_job picks the approach). Coverage and review gaps are reported honestly. Pass job or task.

tools.name: get_job_templates
tools.description: For team jobs: JOB-METHOD.md (the short team method), JOB-RECORDS.md (every record field; open it only when advance_job refuses a record) and the delivery templates.

tools.name: get_job_preferences
tools.description: On this anonymous service, return recommended choices and a local-file template. Signed-in connections use the scoped private preference record. No private data is loaded publicly.

tools.name: set_job_preferences
tools.description: Anonymous calls only prepare local preference files; they save nothing on the server. Signed-in connections require the selected workspace write consent. An ordinary one-off request never changes saved defaults.

tools.name: find_specialist
tools.description: Find worker candidates for a deliverable. Compare their remit and outputs, then use prepare_specialist to onboard the chosen worker. Keep unrelated private context out of discovery.

tools.name: prepare_specialist
tools.description: Supply role_id only to load a complete base specialist: README, setup, SOUL, intake, playbook, handoff and best-practice files, pinned methods and a full ZIP download. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_outcome_pattern, get_approaches, search_library, plan_workflow, get_resource, prepare_workflow, get_item, search, fetch · Private data: start_outcome, advance_outcome, record_outcome_decision, record_outcome_experiment, prepare_outcome_pattern, advance_job, get_job_templates, get_job_preferences, set_job_preferences, find_specialist, prepare_specialist, plan_workflow, get_resource, get_item, fetch · Public sink: record_outcome_experiment, prepare_outcome_pattern, prepare_job_context, start_job, advance_job, plan_workflow, prepare_workflow · Destructive: start_outcome, advance_outcome, advance_job, prepare_workflow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_outcome_pattern, get_approaches, search_library, plan_workflow, get_resource, prepare_workflow, get_item, search, fetch · Private data: start_outcome, advance_outcome, record_outcome_decision, record_outcome_experiment, prepare_outcome_pattern, advance_job, get_job_templates, get_job_preferences, set_job_preferences, find_specialist, prepare_specialist, plan_workflow, get_resource, get_item, fetch · Public sink: record_outcome_experiment, prepare_outcome_pattern, prepare_job_context, start_job, advance_job, plan_workflow, prepare_workflow · Destructive: start_outcome, advance_outcome, advance_job, prepare_workflow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
